name: Gunner
description: Ginger beer, lime and Angostura, the Hong Kong club classic. A few dashes of bitters; trace alcohol.
history: Served at the Royal Hong Kong Yacht Club and colonial-era clubs since the 1920s, traditionally half ginger beer and half ginger ale with lime cordial.
whyItWorks: Bitters give ginger beer the depth a spirit would; lime keeps it sharp.
steps: Build lime, syrup and bitters over ice.
Top with ginger beer and stir.
techniqueNotes: The original uses half ginger ale for a softer bite; all ginger beer is spicier.

recommendedBottles.rationale: The bitters the drink is built on.
